title: Heterogeneous Agent Collaborative Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.02604v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Heterogeneous Agent Collaborative Reinforcement Learning (HACRL), a new Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Reward (RLVR) problem that addresses the inefficiencies of isolated multi-agent on-policy optimization. HACRL enables collaborative optimization with independent execution: heterogeneous agents share verified rollouts during training to mutually improve, while operating independently at inference time. Unlike LLM-based multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), HACRL does not require coordinated deployment, and unlike on-/off-policy distillation, it enables bidirectional mutual learning among heterogeneous agents rather than one-directional homogeneous teacher-to-student transfer. Building on this problem, we propose HACPO, a collaborative RL algorithm that enables principled rollout sharing to maximize sample utilization and cross-agent knowledge transfer. translated_title: 异构智能体协同强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了异构智能体协同强化学习，这是一个新的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）问题，旨在解决孤立多智能体在线策略优化的低效问题。HACRL 实现了协作优化与独立执行的结合：异构智能体在训练期间共享经验证的轨迹以相互提升，同时在推理阶段独立运行。与基于 LLM 的多智能体强化学习（MARL）不同，HACRL 不需要协调部署；与在线/离线策略蒸馏不同，它实现的是异构智能体之间的双向互学习，而非单向的同构教师到学生的知识传递。基于这一问题，我们提出了 HACPO，一种协同强化学习算法，能够进行有原则的轨迹共享，以最大化样本利用率和跨智能体的知识传递。为了缓解能力差异和策略分布（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出新的RLVR问题HACRL及协同算法HACPO，使异构智能体在训练中共享经验证的轨迹以实现双向互学习、推理时独立运行，从而最大化样本利用率与跨智能体知识传递。
en_tdlr: Proposes HACRL, a new RLVR problem, and the HACPO algorithm, which enables heterogeneous agents to share verified rollouts during training for bidirectional mutual learning while operating independently at inference, maximizing sample utilization and cross-agent knowledge transfer.
